name: markdown-accept-extensions
body: The markdown frontend must accept exactly the markdown extension set `.md` and `.markdown` (DECIDED; `.mdx` is OUT — it is JSX-embedded and not the markdown frontend's concern, at most a later feature). For each accepted file it emits a Module node for its directory — FQN = `<language-root>.` + the directory's absolute path (`md.<absolute-path>`, the path-derived collision-free module identity, see markdown-sections-as-symbols) — and a File node whose FQN is the absolute path, extension retained — never dropping the file (all-code-included: filtering is by code_type, not by omission). AC: a repo containing .md and .markdown files produces a module and a file node for each, with no file absent from the graph; a `.mdx` file produces no markdown node (not accepted by the markdown frontend).
